data.name: kw.init
data.value: Entry point that runs once when the object is initialized.

data.name: kw.frame
data.value: Entry point that runs every frame.

data.name: kw.frame_ai
data.value: Entry point that runs every frame instead of `frame` while the vehicle is controlled by the AI.

data.name: kw.end
data.value: Ends the current block.

data.name: kw.if
data.value: Executes the following commands if `Stack0` is not 0. The value stays on the stack.

data.name: kw.else
data.value: Starts the commands that are executed if `Stack0` was 0.

data.name: kw.endif
data.value: Ends the condition.

data.name: kw.macro
data.value: Defines a macro that can be called with `(M.L.name)`.

data.name: kw.trigger
data.value: Defines a trigger that runs when the event with this name occurs.

data.name: trigger.keyboard
data.value: Runs when the key bound to `{0}` is pressed. `{0}_off` runs when it is released.

data.name: trigger.collision
data.value: Runs when the vehicle collides with something. `coll_pos_x`, `coll_pos_y`, `coll_pos_z` and `coll_energy` describe the collision.

data.name: trigger.int_haltewunsch
data.value: Runs when a passenger requests a stop.

data.name: trigger.railbond_#
data.value: Runs when axle # passes a rail joint.

data.name: trigger.ai_scheduled_settarget
data.value: Runs when the line and destination of a scheduled vehicle are set. The line is in `SetLineTo`, the destination index in `AI_target_index`.

data.name: trigger.ai_scheduled_setbusstop
data.value: Runs when the next stop of a scheduled vehicle changes. The stop name is in `act_busstop`.

data.name: trigger.malfunction_gettime
data.value: Runs when the player requests a repair. Leave the repair time in minutes in `Stack0`.

data.name: trigger.malfunction_reset
data.value: Runs when the player accepts a repair.

data.name: trigger.veh_tank
data.value: Runs every frame while the vehicle is refueled.
